start.text: (The nurse at the desk looks up.) You've got a face I've seen. Never mind - on a double shift everybody's face looks like someone's.

remembers.text: (The nurse at the desk looks up, then looks again.) You. The Cubbon bus. You let me sleep all the way to the park.

rules.text: Sister Lalitha. Day shift, this week. Stay this side of the red line. That door is isolation. Nobody goes in, nobody asks.

isolation.text: Patients. (She writes something in the register and doesn't look up again.) Eat your idli. It's not going to get warmer.

discharge.text: When the doctor signs. The doctor signs on Thursdays. Some Thursdays.

again.text: Red line. Idli. Rest. In that order.
